samples.question: Follow the connected route from the amber triangle to the teal circle. It has nine V-shaped teeth. In route order, write a dark cell for a tooth pointing up and a light cell for a tooth pointing down, filling a 3 by 3 tile left-to-right and top-to-bottom. Which symbol appears: X, plus, T, or L?
